title: Container-Presenter Pattern — React Examples
description: Runnable container-presenter examples: custom hook container with derived view, pure typed presenter, legacy class container with PropTypes, and presenter isolation tests with Testing Library.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables del patrón container-presenter: custom hook como container con vista derivada, presenter puro tipado, container de clase legacy con PropTypes y tests aislados del presenter con Testing Library.
